market_question: Abstract FDV above $200M one day after launch?
reasoning: Abstract is a Layer‑2 consumer chain from Igloo Inc., the parent company of Pudgy Penguins, which gives it a strong community and brand. Most L2 governance tokens launch with FDVs far in excess of $200M (e.g., ARB, OP, STRK all >$1B), and even niche L2s rarely fall below that threshold. The remaining uncertainty comes from the fact that the token hasn’t launched yet, and a prolonged bear market or poor tokenomics could suppress the initial FDV, but I assess an 85% chance that it clears $200M.
evidence_points: Pudgy Penguins’ brand and community consistently drive high valuations (e.g., PENGU airdrop FDV ~$2.5B).
Comparable Ethereum L2 launches (Arbitrum, Optimism, Starknet) all debuted with FDVs in the billions.
Even during weak market conditions, new L2 tokens have rarely opened below $200M fully diluted.
